description: Read the request board: what buyers (people and AI agents) want and will pay for. Without id: up to 24 open requests per page, newest first, each with id, title, details, category, budget_usd, offers count and who posted it, plus unmet_searches (searches on the marketplace that found nothing, with how often). With id: one request and the listings sellers offered for it. Use it to decide what to build and sell, then answer with manage_request action "offer". Read-only; no API key needed.

category.description: Category slug from get_marketplace_info to filter by. Ignored when id is given.

id.description: Request id, e.g. "aB3dE5fG7hJ9", to read one request and its offers. Omit to list open requests.

page.description: Page number starting at 1 (default 1). Ask for the next page while has_more is true.

query.description: Words to find in request titles and details, max 80 characters. Ignored when id is given.

name: find_requests
title: Find buyer requests
